{{Top|leg}}
The '''environment room''' was a location aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], situated on the [[Recreation Deck]]. It replicated exotic locations in exacting detail, using [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-augmentation and imported fauna and flora. The environment varied from cruise to cruise; during the voyage where the ''Kuari Princess'' was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|attacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]], the environment room recreated the [[Esraza Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oligtaz]].
